newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Drunken Vietnam soldiers kill seven in rampage.
newsitem.headline: Drunken Vietnam soldiers kill seven in rampage.

text.p: Military and police authorities in central Vietnam were investigating on Thursday a bloody shooting rampage in which two drunken border soldiers killed seven people and injured four others.

Military officials in Thua-Thien Hue province told Reuters that search teams were trying to track down the two men who escaped on Tuesday with ammunition after killing the family of a district tax official and several others following an argument.
"We are co-operating with provincial police to hunt for those men, but it's difficult because the area is in mountains and near the border (with Laos)," one officer said.
According to local press reports the soldiers used their guns to threaten the tax official's son while drinking.
The weapons were seized and taken to the tax chief's home. The soldiers followed later and killed him, his wife, and two children. Another relative was shot and wounded.
The other victims, including several soldiers, were shot as the pair made their escape, seizing bullets from a border post as they fled.
Violent incidents involving members of Vietnam's security forces are considered rare.
